subject: Compliance handoff + co-sell next steps
messages:
From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@acme.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: legal@acme.com
Date: 2025-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood compliance artifacts for AWS Marketplace co-sell

Sofia / Redwood team,

We're kicking off the AWS co-sell readiness review on our side. AWS partner ops asked for the following artifacts to complete the security pass and enable co-sell listing for Acme: SOC2 Type II (most recent), a pen test summary/attestation, and an executed DPA. Can you confirm which of these you can share as PDFs versus links, and whether any items need redaction for vendor-sensitive details?

We have a short internal deadline: AWS wants materials in a shared folder by EOD Tuesday (Nov 20) to hit their review cycle. If there's any reason that's not possible, please let us know ASAP so we can ask for an extension.

Thanks,
Jamie Cole
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Acme Corp

Attachments: none
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, legal@acme.com
Date: 2025-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance artifacts for AWS Marketplace co-sell

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list and the deadline. We're on it. Quick plan below:

- SOC2 Type II 2024: we will provide a redacted PDF (governance controls and high-level scope only).
- Pen test: we can share an executive summary PDF plus a letter from the third-party vendor confirming remediation status; full raw findings are restricted but we can provide an internal redaction-safe summary.
- DPA: we can execute Acme's DPA or send our standard DPA for signature — whichever you prefer.

I will drop the files into a shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign link for the DPA if you want us to initiate. Expect the SOC2 + PenTest executive summary by EOD today.

Please confirm if Acme needs the full scope matrix for AWS (list of subservices) or if the high-level artifact set above suffices for partner ops.

Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Partner Security Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2024.pdf (attached, PDF, 4.1 MB); PenTest-Executive-Summary-Redwood-2025.pdf (attached, PDF, 1.2 MB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@acme.com>, legal@acme.com
Date: 2025-11-19T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance artifacts for AWS Marketplace co-sell

Sofia — quick operational question from the sales side: do we want to push the DocuSign for the DPA now or wait for Acme to route their template back? If we send our DPA and Acme counters quickly we can avoid a bottleneck with partner ops review. Also attaching the marketplace-co-sell-checklist.xlsx I put together — it maps each required item (SOC2, PenTest, DPA) to the owner for upload and expected format.

If Marissa can own DocuSign initiation, I'll follow up with AWS partner ops to confirm the folder path and make sure Gina (AWS) sees the artifacts in their portal.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: marketplace-co-sell-checklist.xlsx (attached, sheet listing owners and deadlines)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@acme.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com, legal@acme.com, Gina Morales <gina.morales@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T14:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance artifacts for AWS Marketplace co-sell — DPA and folder link

Hi all — follow up after internal legal review: we went ahead and populated the shared Drive with the redacted SOC2 and the pen test executive summary. I've also initiated DocuSign for the DPA (we used Acme's template per Jamie's preference) — DocuSign link below is live and is set to route to Acme legal next. Once signed we'll upload the executed PDF to the same Drive folder and provide the final link to AWS partner ops.

DocuSign (Acme DPA): https://www.docusign.net/Acme-RW-DPA-link
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-example-evidence

Summary of what's in the folder now:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2024.pdf (redacted, governance scope)
- PenTest-Executive-Summary-Redwood-2025.pdf (summary + attestation letter)
- marketplace-co-sell-checklist.xlsx (owners + deadlines)

Next steps (owners):
- Acme legal: sign DPA (DocuSign) — target 48 hours
- Ben: confirm with AWS partner ops that folder is discoverable in their portal
- Sofia: coordinate any small redactions Acme requests (we can produce one updated SOC2 page if needed)

If Acme needs an additional attestation (e.g., IP/segregation details for the dedicated deployment), flag it here and we'll scope it with legal.

Marissa Cole
Head, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (610) 555-0192
